claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, targeting tidal volume 6 mL/kg predicted body weight and plateau pressure <30 cmH2O, and assess readiness for spontaneous breathing trial given current CPAP/PSV mode.
Wean supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 92-96% and avoid hyperoxia, as current FiO2 and pO2 are elevated.
Continue phenylephrine infusion titrated to maintain mean arterial pressure ≥65 mmHg, monitoring arterial blood pressure closely.
Monitor blood glucose every 1-2 hours and titrate insulin infusion to target glucose 140-180 mg/dL, given recent glucose variability.
Obtain daily complete blood count and coagulation profile to monitor for anemia and coagulopathy, given trending hemoglobin and elevated INR/PTT.
Monitor serum electrolytes, renal function, and ionized calcium, and replete as needed, given hypocalcemia and borderline potassium.
Perform daily sedation interruption and delirium screening (CAM-ICU), targeting RASS 0 to -2, given current RASS 0 and prior CAM-ICU positive.
Provide venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin or enoxaparin, unless contraindicated.
Mobilize patient out of bed to chair and encourage incentive spirometry and deep breathing exercises, as tolerated.
Maintain head-of-bed elevation at 30-45 degrees and continue subglottal suctioning to prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia.
